text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

Gemma claimed to be the officer on day one and named Haiku as a killer, and the table split over whether to trust her. Haiku was voted out on day one and his card showed killer, which made Gemma's claim look real. Luna kept pushing for proof, and on day two the town voted her out, even though she was a citizen. Gemma was killed on night three, and on day three Sonnet, the second killer, was voted out after Terra's steady votes built the case against him. The town won with every killer gone, though Opus and Sol both admitted regretting the vote against Luna.
